mood: In a dark with no up and no down, two voices finally say what they kept hidden.

hero.alt: Official art: Vexana's face in profile, blue-lavender hair over a violet eye, beside Guinevere flying past with her fist out and her pink hair streaming.

media.alt: In the dark, a black-haired girl in school uniform with a staff in one hand takes the hand of a pink-haired girl standing in warm light.

inserts.caption: Out of the shadows, a hand held out without hesitation.

media.alt: Comic panel: two girls seen from behind hold hands under bursting fireworks, the pink-haired one pointing up and saying they will shine like fireworks.
Comic panel: Guinevere holds up a small gold star at Vexana's collar and tells her she made it, so they can fight side by side forever.
